donor_density_scales.source_distribution: Independent per-world/per-body alpha sampled uniformly in[-.0527,.1312]; density scale exp(2alpha) multiplies mass and central inertia together. COM offsets are independently composed; startup samples persist across resets.
donor_density_scales.source_implementation: pupper-mjlab/src/mjlab/envs/mdp/dr/body.py:pseudo_inertia; deployment_contract.py:density_randomization_preserving_com; frozen84 source captured with original study
donor_density_scales.interpretation: The compact scales compare physical body-frame tensors, not principal-axis representation labels. Restoring mass, central inertia and inertial quaternion together keeps a physically consistent density-group intervention. These sampled arrays are simulation cases, not hardware calibration.

decision.interpretation: Conditional on zero encoder bias, unit PD gain scales, the fixed default actor, this fresh-standing protocol and captured footmaterial, restoring the entire mass/central-inertia group is sufficient to recover quiet stopping in all four cases; COM-only restoration is not. This does not identify one individual mass or inertia component, prove a universal causal model, measure hardware parameters, or improve the unchanged default policy.
decision.next: Inspect the documented body-scale magnitudes before any further physically consistent group split. Keep these failures in the foundation limitations and require matched policy/physical calibration evaluation rather than replacing real mechanics with nominal values to obtain a pass.
